generic_domain.justification: Reinforcement Learning is the broadest domain in the provided list as it encompasses both 'Contextual RL' and 'Visual RL'. Contextual RL refers to reinforcement learning with additional context, which can be seen as a specific application or extension within the broader reinforcement learning framework. Similarly, Visual RL deals specifically with visual inputs, which again falls under the larger umbrella of Reinforcement Learning. Therefore, 'Reinforcement Learning' serves as the most comprehensive and general domain that includes all other specified domains.
